messages:
alex: Hey folks — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/11547 :rocket:
alex: Summary: per-model routing policy + small defensive change to routing merge order. Touches runtime request router and platform API validation. Expect low-risk, but touches infra-visible configs. Hoping to merge today if no blockers.
chris: taking a look now. main risk is KV cache key shaping with the new merge order — can you paste the failing case you tried? :eyes:
alex: repro case I used: requests that differ only in model_tag should still hit same cache unless explicit routing set. snippet:```py
# pseudo
def route(req):
    base = req.prefix
    if req.model_tag:
        return model_route(req.model_tag)
    return default_route(base)
```
maya: I skimmed the API bits — two quick q's: 1) is this backwards compatible for existing console route configs? 2) any migration steps for Dedicated customers?
alex: 1) yes, defaults preserve old behavior. 2) no DB schema changes; for Dedicated I'll open an ops PR to update config ship.
sam: infra note: we need a small manifest tweak because the new feature reads an env var on startup. Can we keep env var optional? can't roll infra change until next deploy window unless we use default.
alex: env var is optional in this patch, falls back to REDWOOD_DEFAULT_ROUTER. I've left a TODO to make it configurable via manifest.
ci-bot: integration/e2e-batch failing — logs attached: "batch-test timeout at step 3"
chris: hm that e2e failure might be flaky. I can re-run locally, but also suggest adding a guard around the async routing path to avoid NPEs. small change, I can push a follow-up.
maya: sounds good. I'm +1 on the API changes once chris's guard goes in and CI passes.
sam: I'll hold infra approval until you open the manifest PR. ping me when it's up and I'll review.
nina: security quick check: does the change introduce any new user-controlled fields that could be abused to route to internal-only models? if so we need an allowlist.
alex: good catch — routing field is model_tag which was already user-visible. This change doesn't expose new fields; I'll add a one-line note in the PR describing allowlist rationale.
chris: pushed a tiny commit suggestion in the PR with the guard. once CI green i'll mark runtime review approved.
ci-bot: integration/e2e-batch — re-run passed.
chris: re-checking, looks fine now. runtime review: approved.
maya: platform review: approved. :+1:
sam: pending manifest PR from alex, will review after.
alex: opened infra PR for manifests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3421 — pinging @sam. will merge once infra PR approved + security note added.
alex: thanks everyone — plan: wait for sam + nina signoffs, then merge and monitor console. will post follow-up in #eng-runtime release thread.
